text_block_list.text:
One morning during Tracen's summer
camp, I notice Мэдзиро Райан
walking toward
me, stretching her arms.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer! Looking forward to
another great workout!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, my engines are rearing to go!
Your training might have
something to do
with that. Ah, right, the morning meeting!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
One after the other, trainees congregate
in the lobby of the camp
dorm. The head
trainer then steps forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We've reached the halfway point of the
summer camp, and I'm sure
you're starting
to feel the effects of your training. No
doubt you want
to test out your new skills.
text_block_list.name: Head Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Which is why we're holding scrimmages on
the last day of the camp! If
you're
interested, let your trainers know, and
they will apply in your
stead!
text_block_list.name: Head Trainer

text_block_list.text:
At the moment, we already have one
participant... Огури Кэп!
text_block_list.name: Head Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're telling me I could race against
Oguri?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've had my eyes on Oguri ever since
she transferred to this
school.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have a fancy family name
supporting her. She gets by on
pure
talent... She's the real deal.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... can you sign me up for the
scrimmages? I want to race
Oguri.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll show her everything I've got!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which... we better come up
with a workout routine if we
wanna beat
Oguri!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oguri's acceleration at the end of the race
is her secret weapon. She's
a late surger,
just like me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But is it a good idea to stick to the same
strategy here?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Two strategies immediately come to mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We could refine our current strategy and
face Огури Кэп head-on.
Or... we could
surprise her with a pace chaser strategy
and try to get
ahead of her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I relay these options to Мэдзиро Райан and
tell her the choice is hers.
After pondering
for a while, she raises her head.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I want to try the pace chaser strategy!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Normally, I'd want to face her
head-on—make it a battle of the
surgers.
But I want to expand my horizons and try
something new!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are full of conviction—even more
so than usual. I can easily
tell how badly
she wants to win this.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: All right, then pace chaser training it is!

text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Since our strategy requires keeping a
steady pace over a long period,
we need
to work on my stamina!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
A teensy bit of stamina training ain't gonna
take me down! Come on,
muscles, lemme
hear you cry out! Your pain, my gain!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: All right, let's take a break.

text_block_list.text: Got it! Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time, but we should
be—huh?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Just then, a sudden gust of wind hits the
two of us. In that moment, I
see a white
blur out of the corner of my eye...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wait... Was that Oguri?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure of it! I'd never miss that
silvery hair of hers! That
sprint... She must
be training like crazy too.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...Good. I wouldn't wanna fight Oguri if she
wasn't gonna give it her
all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Moved by Огури Кэп's determination,
Мэдзиро Райан softly smiles. As I
stand by her
side, I notice a few trainees gossiping
behind us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey... Was that Oguri? I thought she was
in a slump...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I bet that's why she's training so
hard.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
A slump... Sounds like the pace chaser
strategy was the right choice.
We can
definitely catch her off guard at this rate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It was just for a moment, but I caught a
glimpse of Oguri's face when
she ran by.
She looked so determined. No way could
you call that a
slump.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
When you're prepping for a big race,
you've gotta believe you can do
it.
Otherwise, there's no way you could run
like that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Believing in yourself... In that case...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The day of the scrimmage arrives, and
from what I can tell, Огури Кэп
is in
tip-top shape, just like Мэдзиро Райан
predicted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, racers, get into position. Ready,
set... go!
text_block_list.name: Head Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Oguri, I've always looked up to you, but
now... I'm gonna surpass you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oguri's in a great position! Ah, but so is
Ryan! Ohhh... I can't wait to
see the final
dash for the finish line!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: This is me... This is how Мэдзиро Райан runs!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oguri's pulled ahead, but Ryan's not far
behind! They're doing it!
They're facing
each other head-on!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: They're neck and neck! Who will win?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Rats. Thought I had her there, but
she beat me good.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for changing our strategy midway
through... Seeing Oguri take
her training
so seriously made me want to take her on
as a surger.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You bet! That race was so intense! If I had
just been a liiiittle bit
faster, I bet I
could've won!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm disappointed, sure, but I'm not sad at
all. If anything, I'm proud of
myself for
doing things my way!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger—strong enough that
I won't lose to Огури Кэп
or Mejiro
McQueen ever again!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Trainer... Will you... help me get there?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан shows me the brightest smile
I've ever seen. In that
moment, my
conviction to make her dreams come true
grows even
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
